Neural Network Pruning via Hessian Eigenspectrum Analysis

Abstract
Overparameterized neural networks contain significant redundancy. In this work, we propose a second-order pruning criterion based on the Hessian eigenspectrum.

1. Introduction
Modern deep networks achieve high accuracy at the cost of substantial compute.

2. Methods
We compute the top eigenvalues of the empirical Fisher information matrix across 50 epochs.

3. Results
Our method achieves 85% sparsity on ResNet-50 while maintaining 99.2% of baseline ImageNet accuracy.

4. Discussion
Second-order curvature provides superior sensitivity compared to magnitude pruning.

References
1. LeCun, Y. et al. (1990). Optimal Brain Damage. NIPS.

Efficacy of Monoclonal Antibodies in Mild-to-Moderate Ulcerative Colitis: A Randomized Controlled Trial

Abstract
Background: Biologic therapies have transformed inflammatory bowel disease management. Methods: We conducted a double-blind, placebo-controlled phase III trial (N=420).

Introduction
Ulcerative colitis causes chronic relapsing mucosal inflammation.

Methods
Patients were randomized 1:1 to subcutaneous antibody or placebo for 52 weeks.

Results
Clinical remission at week 12 was achieved in 48% vs 21% (p < 0.001).

Discussion
The safety profile was consistent with previous trials.

References
1. Rutgeerts, P. et al. (2005). Infliximab for induction and maintenance therapy. NEJM.

Thermodynamic Limits of Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide Mineralization in Basaltic Formations

Abstract
In situ carbon mineralization in mafic and ultramafic rocks offers permanent carbon sequestration. We model dissolution kinetics.

1. Introduction
Mitigating anthropogenic emissions requires gigaton-scale carbon removal.

2. Methodology
Reactive transport modeling was performed using TOUGHREACT.

3. Results
Over 95% of injected CO2 is converted to carbonate minerals within 24 months.

References
1. Matter, J.M. et al. (2016). Rapid carbon mineralization for permanent disposal. Science.

Monetary Policy Transmission and Bank Liquidity Hoarding in Post-Crisis Economies

Abstract
We examine how central bank balance sheet expansion impacts interbank lending markets.

1. Introduction
Unconventional monetary policy has reshaped credit intermediation.

2. Empirical Strategy
Using administrative loan records from 150 European banks, we estimate a difference-in-differences specification.

3. Findings
Banks with higher sovereign debt exposure curtailed commercial lending.

References
1. Bernanke, B.S. (2020). The New Tools of Monetary Policy. AER.

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels):
        super(ResidualBlock, self).__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)

def train_epoch(model, dataloader, optimizer, criterion):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    for batch_idx, (data, target) in enumerate(dataloader):
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        output = model(data)
        loss = criterion(output, target)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
    return total_loss / len(dataloader)

Specific Aims
Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) represents an unmet clinical need lacking targeted therapies. Our overarching hypothesis is that microvascular endothelial stiffening drives myocardial diastolic dysfunction.

Aim 1: Determine the molecular mechanism of endothelial mechanotransduction via Piezo1 channels.
Aim 2: Evaluate the therapeutic efficacy of selective Piezo1 antagonists in a murine multi-hit HFpEF model.

Project Narrative
Heart disease remains the primary cause of mortality in the United States.
